summary: Proof-worth entries for daemon-owned native pixel acquisition and public capture transfer.

entries.contract: Direct and saved native capture use one deadline-bounded daemon broker transaction, full canonical topology revalidation, explicit public exclusions, exact-generation callback quarantine and late-authority warm reconvergence, source-labeled best-effort window fallback, owner/bounds-bound no-fallback exact-channel capture, exact-integer closed-shape IPC, bounded NDJSON reads, and the existing output policy without a second production ScreenCaptureKit owner.
entries.worth: This prevents public capture from overlapping warm DesktopWorld streams, reopening before uncertain native callbacks settle, failing to reconverge after late authority, trusting duplicated caller geometry or lossy numbers, returning stale or display-cropped pixels under exact-channel provenance, leaking capture artifacts into transport, hanging on a byte-drip peer, growing an unterminated frame without bound, or truncating frames above the normal socket queue budget.
entries.command: node --test tests/public-capture-transfer.test.mjs tests/exact-channel-capture-contract.test.mjs tests/daemon/spatial-refresh-stale-write.test.mjs tests/daemon-session-reader.test.mjs tests/desktop-pixel-broker-contract.test.mjs tests/desktop-frame-texture-native.test.mjs tests/toolkit/runtime-canvas-host-runtime.test.mjs && bash tests/display-topology-contract.sh && bash tests/daemon-ipc-schema.sh && node --test tests/schemas/daemon-event.test.mjs
entries.guard: focused production Swift owners, fake native callbacks, schema fixtures, in-memory bytes, and hermetic temporary compiler/test artifacts only; no production AOS binary, daemon socket, GUI, TCC, or native capture

entries.contract: The reusable supervised proof uses two overlapping layer-zero windows from one synthetic process to verify exact channel pixels, exact AX membership, sibling-subtree rejection, rejected-refresh preservation, missing-target no-fallback failure, authenticated pre/post geometry commitments, and complete cleanup through public focus and see commands.
entries.worth: This detects the live regression where a channel could label display-cropped pixels, changed fixture geometry, or whole-app AX facts as one selected window, while keeping private application content, raw geometry checkpoint data, retained or logged raw pixels, daemon lifecycle, and new permission requests outside the proof.
entries.guard: The registered command performs direct checkpoint and supervision module tests, static assertions, Swift typecheck, classifier self-test, and owned-process cleanup tests only; recovery state contains keyed digests rather than raw unrelated-channel metadata, and the explicit AOS_EXACT_FOCUS_CHANNEL_NATIVE_PROOF_OK=1 route is the separate supervised live proof against the already-running repo daemon.
